summary: Defines an ad hoc command as using `/usr/bin/ansible` to automate a single task on one or more managed nodes. Ad hoc commands are quick but not reusable, and their concepts carry over to playbooks.
questions: What is an ad hoc command in Ansible?
Are ad hoc commands reusable like playbooks?
Which binary runs Ansible ad hoc commands?

answer_card.title: What an ad hoc command is
answer_card.answer_md: An ad hoc command uses the `/usr/bin/ansible` CLI to run **one task** against one or more managed nodes. They're quick and easy but **not reusable**; the concepts carry directly over to playbooks. Read the inventory docs first.
